q: How many weapons are in GTA 6?
a: Over 40 distinct weapons have been identified through official trailers, development documents, and community analysis.

q: How does the weapon inventory system work in GTA 6?
a: GTA 6 implements a limited on-person inventory system inspired by Red Dead Redemption 2, with the remaining arsenal stored in your personal vehicle trunk.

q: What is the vehicle trunk armory mechanic?
a: Personal vehicles act as mobile weapon lockers to equip heavier assault rifles, shotguns, RPGs, and tactical body armor.

q: What real-life firearms are featured in GTA 6?
a: Counterparts include the Klose K17 (Glock 17), Girardi ES9 (SIG Sauer P226), Shrewsbury AKM (Kalashnikov AKM), and Duke Arms 556 (AR-15 / M4A1).

q: Can weapons be customized and upgraded in GTA 6?
a: Yes. Players can visit Ammu-Nation stores and workbenches for suppressors, extended magazines, red dot optics, and custom finishes.

q: Who are the main playable characters in GTA 6?
a: GTA 6 stars dual outlaw protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos navigating crime across the state of Leonida.

q: Who is Lucia Caminos in GTA 6?
a: Lucia Caminos is the first female playable protagonist in modern 3D Grand Theft Auto history, beginning her journey after parole from Leonida Penitentiary.

q: Who is Jason Duval in GTA 6?
a: Jason Duval is a former military enlistee who grew up among crooks and grifters in the Florida Keys, handling coastal smuggling in Key Lento.

q: How does character switching work between Jason and Lucia?
a: Players can switch between Jason and Lucia seamlessly in real time during free roam and coordinate positioning during missions.

q: How large is the GTA 6 Leonida map compared to GTA 5?
a: Community cartography projects estimate Leonida to be approximately 2.5 to 3 times the landmass of GTA V with extensive water navigation and interiors.

q: What are the five confirmed counties in GTA 6?
a: Leonida consists of Vice-Dale County, Kelly County, Mariana County (The Keys), Leonard County, and Lummox County.

q: What percentage of buildings have enterable interiors?
a: An estimated 60% to 70% of commercial storefronts feature walk-in interiors with interactive robbery mechanics.

q: Can you travel seamlessly to the Florida Keys without loading screens?
a: Yes. The entire map of Leonida is completely open and seamless with zero loading screens.

q: Can cheat codes be used in GTA Online / GTA 6 Online?

q: Is there an unlimited money cheat in GTA 6?
